proposals.evidence: DEDR 3986 full article: Ka. pal id.; palla elephant; halive, halaku, halike, halube, haluve a toothed harrow. Koḍ. pallï tooth. Tu. paru animal's tooth. Te. palu, pallu ( pl. paṇḍlu), pannu (back-formation from pl. ) tooth; ( VPK )… The article gives Tamil/Kannada pal “tooth”; Census haḷḷu is the regional p/h form of this tooth base.
